section_about:
We are looking for a versatile corporate and regulatory lawyer to join Cohere's Legal team.
Reporting to our Senior Governance Counsel, this role will support a global portfolio of corporate governance, entity and intercompany matters, together with cross-border regulatory, trade and compliance workstreams.
This role is designed for a lawyer with a strong corporate foundation who has also developed meaningful regulatory and trade experience.
You should be comfortable moving between different types of legal work including:
- supporting global corporate governance and entity matters, including subsidiary governance, entity establishment and restructuring, intercompany arrangements and delegated authorities;
- supporting cross-border regulatory workstreams, including foreign investment and national-security reviews, regulatory diligence and filing coordination;
- helping the business navigate export-control, sanctions and related compliance requirements; and
- supporting legal and regulatory issues arising from public-sector and regulated-market opportunities, particularly where sovereignty, procurement, security or other market-access requirements come into play.
You will work closely with colleagues across Legal, Finance, Tax, People, Security, Government Affairs and commercial teams, as well as with specialist external counsel in multiple jurisdictions.
The role requires sound judgment, curiosity and the ability to take ownership of a workstream, identify when specialist advice is needed, and turn that advice into practical action.
section_responsibilities:
- Support Cohere's global corporate governance and entity matters, including subsidiary governance, entity establishment and restructuring, board and shareholder matters, corporate approvals, delegated authorities, signing frameworks and ongoing entity maintenance.
- Support Cohere's intercompany legal architecture, including intercompany agreements and other cross-border operating arrangements, working closely with Finance, Tax, People and local counsel to ensure Cohere's entities are structured and operated appropriately across jurisdictions.
- Support cross-border regulatory workstreams, including foreign investment screening, national-security reviews, regulatory diligence, filing coordination and the implementation of regulatory commitments arising in connection with acquisitions, investments, restructurings and other significant matters.
- Support Cohere's export-control, sanctions and related compliance matters, including coordinating specialist external advice and translating regulatory requirements into practical internal guidance, controls and documentation.
- Support legal and regulatory workstreams arising from public-sector and regulated-market opportunities, particularly where sovereignty, procurement, security or other market-access requirements need to be understood and operationalised.
- Coordinate internal stakeholders and external counsel across jurisdictions, ensuring that legal and regulatory workstreams are appropriately scoped, progressed and implemented.
- Take ownership of matters within the role's remit and help develop practical, scalable approaches as Cohere's international footprint grows.
What we're looking for
- A qualified lawyer with approximately 4-8 years of relevant experience, gained at a leading law firm, a sophisticated in-house legal team, or preferably a combination of both.
- A strong corporate and cross-border legal foundation, with experience across areas such as subsidiary governance, entity structuring and reorganisations, intercompany arrangements, delegated authorities, corporate approvals and other aspects of international corporate practice.
- Meaningful exposure to cross-border regulatory matters, particularly foreign investment screening, national-security reviews, export controls, sanctions, international trade or related corporate compliance issues.
Deep specialism in any one of these areas is not required.
- Experience working across multiple jurisdictions, including coordinating local and specialist external counsel and bringing different legal, regulatory and business inputs together into a coherent internal position.
- Strong judgment, range and commercial awareness, with the ability to get quickly up to speed on unfamiliar issues, identify what matters most and distinguish issues that can be handled internally from those requiring specialist advice.
- The ability to take ownership of an internal legal workstream, ask the right questions of specialist counsel, digest complex advice and translate it into clear, practical next steps for the business.
- Clear and practical communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across Legal, Finance, Tax, People, Security, Government Affairs and commercial teams.
- A collaborative and pragmatic approach, with comfort moving between different subject areas and working across functions, jurisdictions and time zones.
- Experience in technology, AI or another regulated industry would be helpful, but is not essential.
- Exposure to public-sector, government-facing or regulated-market matters is a plus but is not a prerequisite.
- You can move comfortably between corporate and regulatory matters, identify the core issue quickly and make progress even where the work does not fit neatly into a single legal category.
- You can take ownership of a complex cross-border workstream, bring together the right internal stakeholders and external advisers, and drive it through to a practical outcome.
- You know when specialist advice is needed, can frame the right questions for external counsel, and can turn complex advice into clear, actionable guidance for the business.
- You become a trusted execution partner across Cohere's corporate governance and regulatory portfolio, taking meaningful ownership of workstreams and creating capacity for more strategic, cross-functional and government-facing work at the senior level.
HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:
If any of the above doesn't line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.
section_preferred:
- Experience in technology, AI, cloud or infrastructure, or another regulated industry.
- Experience supporting a multinational organisation with a growing international entity footprint, particularly where legal, tax, finance and operational considerations intersect.
- Exposure to public-sector, government-facing or regulated-market matters, including procurement, digital sovereignty, security, accreditation or related market-access requirements.
- Familiarity with North American, UK or EU regulatory frameworks relevant to cross-border technology businesses.

section_intro:
WHO ARE WE?
Join us!
WHY THIS ROLE?
We're building the foundational infrastructure that will define how the world thinks about and deploys AI, and we want the sharpest, most driven, and most curious people to help us do it.
As the head of the Data Foundation pillar of our Analytics and Data Insights team, you'll lead the team that makes Cohere's data trustworthy, governed, and available: the warehouse every analytics surface runs on, the pipelines that keep it fresh, the access model that keeps it secure, and the agentic analytics layer that lets anyone at Cohere (and their agents) ask questions of governed data directly.
Your team owns the full data lifecycle.
You'll run ingestion into BigQuery from internal and external data sources, orchestrate it in Airflow and Cloud Run, model the data warehouse in dbt, and serve the results through Looker, export APIs, and customer-facing analytics surfaces.
Everything is provisioned as code in Terraform, and governance is part of the design: VPC service controls, IAM patterns, and documented access paths that let people and agents move fast without putting data at risk.
This role is both highly visible and highly impactful, and you'll inherit a solid structure on which to build the rest of the stack: a Terraform-provisioned warehouse framework, dbt modeling conventions, an alerting and incident-response practice, and documentation patterns to keep everything discoverable.
The roadmap is set with big bets in flight: scaling that framework across the company, standing up an internal analytics agent with a real eval harness, and consolidating institutional knowledge into a self-correcting and self-maintaining system that keeps context centralized, current, and documented, rather than dispersed and in people's heads.
section_responsibilities:
As the head of the Data Foundation pillar, you will:
- Build and lead the team.
Hire and grow a team of data and infrastructure engineers; set the technical bar; develop strong talent and raise team performance, building leadership capability beneath you.
- Set the roadmap from company strategy.
Own and sequence the Data Foundation roadmap: the warehouse buildout, the agentic analytics program, data governance, and the platform work that unblocks our other pillars.
You'll make the trade-offs and carry the cross-functional impact that comes with them.
- Own the data platform end to end.
Ingestion (managed connectors and an open-source connector framework), orchestration on Airflow and Cloud Run, warehouse modeling in BigQuery with dbt (raw, core, mart layers), and serving through Looker, export APIs, and semantic layers.
All of it provisioned as code in Terraform.
- Own data governance.
Define how humans, service accounts, and agents get access to governed data: VPC service controls, IAM patterns, documented onboarding paths, audit logs, and sensitive requests (including legal holds) handled to deadline.
- Operate for reliability.
Run the alerting and anomaly-detection framework, own data freshness SLAs, lead incident response and postmortems, and turn every incident into a durable standard so the same class of failure doesn't recur.
- Lead the agentic analytics program.
Wire the semantic layer into an internal analytics agent, build the eval harness that measures its accuracy, and make the eval-driven call on where AI earns its way into production.
Apply the same discipline to automating data engineering work itself.
- Set the standard for analytics across the company.
The medallion framework, naming conventions, and testing patterns your team maintains become the way other teams ship analytics data.
You'll onboard new domains onto it and keep the docs accurate to how the systems actually work.
- Partner across the org.
Work with the North product and engineering teams on the analytics surfaces that ship in the product (including a customer-facing analytics export), with Business Insights on marts for the business, with Security on data governance, and with Legal on compliance-critical data requests.
section_requirements:
- 10+ years of experience across data engineering, data infrastructure, or analytics platform work, with a strong management track record leading data platform or infrastructure teams
- Serious hands-on history in data engineering or infrastructure before management.
You can still read a Terraform plan, a dbt DAG, or an Airflow scheduler log and ask the question that matters
- Production experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar), workflow orchestration (Airflow or similar), and infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar)
- Depth in data modeling: you think in fact and dimension tables, raw/core/mart separation, and semantic layers, and you have opinions on where tests and contracts belong
- A record of setting a team's roadmap from company or function strategy and delivering outcomes that span teams, with the cross-functional partnerships to match
- Operational excellence you can point to: alerting you trust, SLAs you meet, incidents you run to ground and write up so they teach
- Exposure to data security and governance: IAM, access management, VPC service controls or equivalent, audit and compliance workflows
- Genuine excitement about AI: you follow the research, have opinions, and are energized by building the data foundation an AI company (and its AI agents) runs on
- Comfort operating in ambiguity, leading a multi-workstream roadmap, and working directly with executives on priorities
If some of the above doesn't line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply!

section_intro:
WHO ARE WE?
Join us!
ABOUT THE ROLE.
We're building the next generation of agentic AI infrastructure at Cohere.
This team sits at the intersection of ML systems, distributed infrastructure, and developer experience, creating the platform that powers autonomous AI agents at scale.
You'll work on hard, forward-looking problems with few established patterns, including secure code execution, agent state management, model routing, identity and authentication, and resource management for long-running agent workflows.
This role is a strong fit for someone who combines systems depth with ML intuition.
You should be comfortable building reliable infrastructure, thinking through distributed systems tradeoffs, and understanding how emerging agentic capabilities shape platform design.
WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON.
- Secure execution environments for agent-generated code
- Identity, authentication, and trust boundaries for agents
- Model routing and orchestration across different model types and environments
- Rate limiting, quotas, and resource management for agent workflows
- State management, memory, and filesystem abstractions for agents.
section_responsibilities:
- Turn emerging ML research ideas into production-ready infrastructure
- Build core platform capabilities for execution, storage, and state management
- Prototype and evaluate new technologies, then help decide what should move into production
- Partner with research teams to shape infrastructure based on what future agent systems will need
section_requirements:
- Experience building production ML infrastructure with strong systems fundamentals
- Hands-on work with agentic systems, multi-agent workflows, or agent development frameworks
- Familiarity with model routing and LLM provider frameworks across different model types and environments
- Experience with scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems and Kubernetes
- A track record of moving quickly on prototypes and making good decisions about productionization.
BONUS
- Experience across on-prem, private cloud, and public cloud environments
- Familiarity with storage systems, embedded databases, or filesystem abstractions
- Experience with code execution sandboxes such as gVisor, Firecracker, Kata, or WASM runtimes
- Interest in emerging ML infrastructure, edge inference, or browser-native models
- Open-source contributions to LLM or agent infrastructure projects
- Experience with identity, workload auth, or capability-based security systems.
HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

section_about:
Cohere seeks a strategic and detail-oriented Financial Analyst to join the budget planning, forecasting, and spend management team that covers multiple high-impact areas.
This role will serve as a key finance partner to business units, providing actionable insights to drive smarter decisions and optimal financial controls.
The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, can juggle complex budget categories, and is comfortable challenging assumptions to ensure fiscal discipline.
You will own the preparation and management of the G&A budget and forecast across Finance, Legal, People, and Corporate Affairs, monitoring headcount, vendor, and operating expenses against plan.
Working closely with department leaders, you will identify variances, provide insights into key cost drivers, and support disciplined resource allocation as the company scales.
Beyond supporting the G&A function, you will also play a key role in driving organization-wide workforce planning.
As our Financial Analyst, you will manage:
- Financial planning: Support roll-up of annual planning company-wide, corporate calendaring, and consolidated P&L
- Budgeting & Forecasting: Build and maintain department-level budgets and company-wide forecasts, working closely with business leaders to align financial plans with operational goals.
- Financial Modeling: Develop dynamic financial models to evaluate business scenarios, investment opportunities, and operational changes.
- Reporting & Variance Analysis: Prepare monthly reporting packages, analyze variances between actuals, forecasts, and budgets, and communicate clear explanations to department leaders
- Business Partnering: Serve as the finance point of contact for G&A budget owners, challenging assumptions and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and cost discipline.
- Data & Systems Management: Leverage financial systems (e.g., NetSuite, Google Sheets/Excel, Pigment) to ensure data accuracy, streamline processes, and improve reporting efficiency.
- Workforce Planning: Support organization-wide workforce planning by developing and maintaining the workforce model, and establishing and refining key headcount and compensation assumptions.
This career opportunity may be a good match for you if you have:
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Accounting, or related quantitative field.
An MBA, CFA, or CPA is a plus.
- 5+ years of progressive experience in FP&A with an emphasis on budget management and running month end operations.
- Expert level Excel/Google Sheets financial modeling skills; familiarity with ERP systems.
- Strong leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills, including effective communication skills at all levels within the Company and the ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Proven ability to deliver change, improve and streamline processes, drive efficiency, and influence stakeholders.
- Ability to thrive in fast-paced, constantly involving environments.
Startup/scaleup experience is a plus.

job_title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Machine Learning
section_intro:
WHO ARE WE?
Join us!
WHY THE COHERE TPM ROLE?
As our Generative Machine Learning organization has continued growing, we are looking for more Technical Program Managers to join the team!
At Cohere, TPMs are pivotal to our success, being seen as operational experts specializing in cross-functional efforts.
Great TPMs at Cohere are well-rounded, executing with precision at the tactical level, while partnering with senior leaders and shaping the big picture at a strategic level, and the opportunities are endless in growing the scale and impact of their work.
Cohere's TPMs would often be described as organized, execution-oriented, pragmatic leaders who are adaptable to the needs of the company and the programs they lead.
As a reward for the depth and breadth of expertize that you bring to the table, you will get to work alongside some of the most talented AI researchers and industry experts in the world on building cutting edge AI technology.
No day will be the same as the one before, and the dynamic high growth environment will be absolutely perfect for anyone excited about solving novel problems, bringing structure to oftentimes chaotic and fast-paced environments, and ambitious about scaling their own impact and growth alongside the company!
Please note: While we are remote-first and accept candidates from all over the world, we are highly prioritizing hiring for people who are within 1-2 hours of British Standard Time (BST).
AS A MACHINE LEARNING TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER, YOU WILL:
- Establish, improve, and scale foundational processes that allow the Generative Modeling teams to execute better, faster, and more predictably
- Scale the operational capacity and effectiveness of the Modeling TPM team in collaboration with the Modeling TPM lead to ensure the function can remain lean and effective during a period of the program portfolio complexity and size continuing to rapidly increase
- Flexibly adapt to the needs of the company, programs, and the team from tackling long-horizon programs that can span quarters or even years to jumping onto often highly ambiguous short-term challenges that can have company-wide impact
- Partner directly with leaders within and outside of the Modeling organization on efforts to design, train and improve our core generative models
- Lead cross-functional, oftentimes company-wide programs and strategic initiatives, collaborating and coordinating with cross-functional teams such as Product, Engineering, Legal, Platform, Infra, Policy, and Finance
- Operate as an organizational expert in improving engineering execution rigor and operations on the ground, while contributing to the strategic layer in areas such as long-term strategic planning with senior modeling leadership
- Map out dependencies and risks, and ensure that cross-functional execution across the program runs smoothly, communicating status with non-technical and technical stakeholders and senior management
- Both own and enable a useful communication flow of priorities, ideas, and knowledge throughout and beyond the Modeling organization in line with your programs
- Respond quickly to program-level changes, clarifying new scope, and managing resource needs in response to evolving priorities
section_requirements:
- 5-10 years as a Technical Program Manager AND 5+ years of experience working directly on AI/ML.
Strong preference for candidates that have worked directly in building foundation models.
- In-depth knowledge of machine learning, particularly when it comes to Natural Language Processing & Large Language Models (LLMs).
Bonus points for experience with Multimodal AI.
- Experience with working in a chaotic, fast paced, low structure environment.
We need someone who is pragmatic, can roll up their sleeves when needed, and can function at the tactical and strategic level to do whatever it takes to make Cohere's models succeed
- Personal hands-on understanding of the unique challenges of managing projects and programs in the AI/ML development space as opposed to traditional software program management
- Managed projects & programs requiring a strong general business acumen, such as coordinating with Finance on reporting needs or Policy on regulatory compliance matters - the broader your experience beyond ML technical program management, the better!
- (optional, but preferred) Have technical experience in a hands-on capacity.
We don't necessarily need someone with hands on experience training models, but you need to feel comfortable sitting in the same rooms with some of the best researchers in the world, working on highly complex, cutting edge ML problems
If some of the above - other than the ML TPM experience - doesn't line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply!
If you consider yourself a thoughtful worker, a lifelong learner, and a kind and playful team member, Cohere is the place for you.
We welcome applicants of all kinds and are committed to providing both an equal opportunity process and work environment.
HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:
If any of the above doesn't line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

section_intro:
WHO ARE WE?
Join us!
WHY THIS ROLE?
We're seeking an exceptional Customer Success Manager with deep expertise in the French public sector and government landscape to lead our most strategic government accounts.
This role requires an individual who understands both the transformative potential of frontier AI and the unique requirements of French government organizations.
section_responsibilities:
STRATEGIC CUSTOMER PARTNERSHIP:
- Own the success, adoption, and growth of Cohere's French public sector customers, ensuring they realize maximum value from our AI solutions
- Build deep, trusted relationships with senior French government stakeholders, including Ministres d'État, Préfets, CIOs, digital transformation leads, and ministerial executives
- Develop comprehensive success plans tailored to each organization's mission, digital strategy, budget cycles (lois de finances), and unique constraints
- Serve as the primary point of contact and executive sponsor for your accounts, managing escalations and ensuring customer satisfaction
- Define and track success metrics aligned with French public sector priorities: citizen satisfaction, service delivery improvements, cost savings, operational efficiency, accessibility outcomes
AI ADOPTION & IMPLEMENTATION LEADERSHIP:
- Guide customers through the full lifecycle of AI adoption-from use case identification and pilot design through production deployment and scaling
- Lead secure AI implementation projects in complex French government environments, including sensitive systems and on-premises deployments
- Navigate the unique challenges of French public sector AI adoption: legacy system integration, data sensitivity, lengthy approval processes (marchés publics), and regulatory compliance requirements
- Create and execute change management strategies to drive user adoption and value realization across diverse government workforces
- Conduct regular executive business reviews with senior stakeholders, demonstrating ROI, impact, and strategic value
- Drive contract renewals and account growth by consistently delivering value and building trusted relationships
CUSTOMER ADVOCACY & PRODUCT INFLUENCE:
- Serve as the voice of the French public sector customers within Cohere, advocating for features and capabilities that address government-specific needs
- Provide strategic feedback to Product and Engineering teams on requirements related to security, explainability, accessibility, French language support, and ethical AI
- Contribute to the development of French public sector-specific offerings, implementation playbooks, documentation, and best practices
- Share customer insights to inform Cohere's French public sector go-to-market strategy and positioning
- Represent Cohere at French government forums, working groups (groupes de travail), roundtables, and industry events
YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF:
REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:
- 8+ years of experience in customer success, account management, strategic consulting, or technology delivery roles within enterprise or French government contexts
- At least 3-5 years working directly with French ministries, regional authorities, or public institutions in a technology, digital transformation, or consulting capacity
- Proven track record of managing complex, strategic accounts with multiple stakeholders, long sales cycles, and multi-year implementation timelines
- Experience leading AI/ML, cloud, or enterprise software implementations in secure or highly regulated environments
- Experience developing and executing customer success strategies, QBRs, and executive engagement programs
- Deep understanding of how French government organizations evaluate, procure (following Code des marchés publics), implement, and govern technology solutions
- Active Confidentiel-Défense or higher security clearance (mandatory)
- Fluent French language proficiency-essential for working across the French public sector
FRENCH PUBLIC SECTOR & GOVERNMENT ACUMEN:
- Comprehensive knowledge of the French public sector ecosystem: central ministries, regional governments (régions), departmental authorities (départements), public enterprises, and critical infrastructure
- Knowledge of relevant legislation and frameworks: RGPD, loi Informatique et Libertés, ANSSI standards, accessibility standards
- Experience with French government cloud strategies and security frameworks: France Cloud, Souveraineté numérique
section_preferred:
- 3+ years specifically managing GenAI, LLM, or conversational AI implementations
- Experience with specific French public sector digital transformation initiatives: France Relance, France 2030
- Direct experience working with French defense, intelligence, public safety, or national security organizations
- Background in management consulting, systems integration, or digital transformation consulting for French public sector clients
HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:
If any of the above doesn't line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

job_title: Customer Success Manager, Public Sector & Defence (Top Secret Clearance)
section_intro:
WHO ARE WE?
Join us!
WHY THIS ROLE?
We're seeking an exceptional Customer Success Manager with deep expertise in the Canadian public sector and defence landscape to lead our most strategic government accounts.
This role requires an individual who understands both the transformative potential of frontier AI and the unique requirements of government and defence organizations.
You will be the trusted advisor and strategic partner for Canadian federal departments, provincial agencies, Crown corporations, defence organizations, and healthcare systems as they navigate the complex journey of AI adoption.
You'll guide organizations through the implementation of frontier AI in secure, highly regulated environments-ensuring solutions deliver a measurable impact while meeting stringent security, privacy, compliance, and ethical requirements.
In this role, you'll collaborate with our Strategic Customer team, Applied ML (AML) Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Platform, Product, and Go-to-Market teams, serving as the voice of the customer internally and the face of Cohere externally for our most sensitive and high-impact government engagements.
You'll have the unique opportunity to shape how Canada's most important institutions leverage AI to serve the public good.
Location: Ottawa (proximity to government customers)
Security Clearance: Active Top Secret clearance is mandatory for this role
section_about:
This is a rare opportunity to shape how Canada's most important institutions leverage AI to serve the public good.
You'll work with organizations responsible for national security, healthcare delivery, social services, and democratic institutions-helping them navigate the profound opportunities and responsibilities that come with deploying frontier AI technology.
You'll need to balance competing demands: innovation velocity with government due diligence, technical possibilities with policy constraints, commercial success with public sector values, and breakthrough capabilities with ethical considerations.
It requires patience, strategic thinking, in-depth sector knowledge, security awareness, and a genuine passion for achieving public service outcomes.
If you're energized by complex challenges, have deep public sector expertise, understand the gravity of working with classified systems, and want to have an outsized impact on Canada's digital future while working with cutting-edge AI technology, this role is for you.
HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:
section_responsibilities:
Strategic Customer Partnership:
- Own the success, adoption, and growth of Cohere's Canadian public sector and defence customers, ensuring they realize maximum value from our AI solutions
- Build deep, trusted relationships with senior government stakeholders, including Deputy Ministers, CIOs, ADMs, digital transformation leads, and departmental executives
- Develop comprehensive success plans tailored to each organization's mission, digital strategy, budget cycles, and unique constraints
- Serve as the primary point of contact and executive sponsor for your accounts, managing escalations and ensuring customer satisfaction
- Define and track success metrics aligned with public sector priorities: citizen satisfaction, service delivery improvements, cost savings, operational efficiency, accessibility outcomes
AI Adoption & Implementation Leadership:
- Guide customers through the full lifecycle of AI adoption-from use case identification and pilot design through production deployment and scaling
- Lead secure AI implementation projects in complex government environments, including air-gapped systems, Protected B/C environments, and on-premises deployments
- Navigate the unique challenges of public sector AI adoption: legacy system integration, data sensitivity, lengthy approval processes, and risk-averse organizational cultures
- Create and execute change management strategies to drive user adoption and value realization across diverse government workforces
- Conduct regular executive business reviews with senior stakeholders, demonstrating ROI, impact, and strategic value
- Drive contract renewals and account growth by consistently delivering value and building trusted relationships
Compliance & Risk Management:
- Ensure all implementations meet Canadian government security protocols, including PBMM standards, security assessments, and authority-to-operate requirements
- Navigate privacy and compliance requirements: Privacy Act, PIPEDA, PHIPA, Access to Information Act, Official Languages Act, accessibility standards
- Lead or support Algorithmic Impact Assessments and responsible AI governance processes as required by Treasury Board directives
- Develop risk mitigation strategies for AI deployments in high-security, mission-critical, and citizen-facing contexts
- Coordinate with customer security teams, privacy officers, legal counsel, and compliance functions
Customer Advocacy & Product Influence:
- Serve as the voice of public sector and defence customers within Cohere, advocating for features and capabilities that address government-specific needs
- Provide strategic feedback to Product and Engineering teams on requirements related to security, explainability, accessibility, bilingualism, and ethical AI
- Contribute to the development of public sector-specific offerings, implementation playbooks, documentation, and best practices
- Share customer insights to inform Cohere's public sector go-to-market strategy and positioning
- Represent Cohere at government forums, working groups, roundtables, and industry events
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
- Partner with Sales to support expansion opportunities, renewals, and new customer acquisition
- Coordinate with Solutions Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers on technical implementation and optimization
- Work with Legal, Security, and Compliance teams to navigate complex procurement, contracting, and regulatory requirements
- Collaborate with Marketing on thought leadership content, case studies, and public sector community building
YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF:
Required Experience:
- 8+ years of experience in customer success, account management, strategic consulting, or technology delivery roles within enterprise or government contexts
- At least 3-5 years working directly with the Canadian government, defence, or healthcare organizations in a technology, digital transformation, or consulting capacity
- Proven track record of managing complex, strategic accounts with multiple stakeholders, long sales cycles, and multi-year implementation timelines
- Experience leading AI/ML, cloud, or enterprise software implementations in secure or highly regulated environments
- Deep understanding of how government organizations evaluate, procure, implement, and govern technology solutions
- Active Top Secret security clearance (mandatory)
Customer Success & Account Management Excellence:
- Demonstrated success driving customer adoption, expansion, and retention in complex enterprise or government accounts
- Experience developing and executing customer success strategies, QBRs, and executive engagement programs
- Track record of identifying and closing expansion opportunities within existing accounts
- Ability to manage multiple strategic accounts simultaneously while maintaining high-touch, personalized engagement
- Experience navigating organizational politics and building coalitions across siloed government departments
Public Sector & Defence Acumen:
- Comprehensive knowledge of the Canadian public sector ecosystem: federal departments, provincial ministries, Crown corporations, defence, intelligence, critical infrastructure, and healthcare
- Deep familiarity with government digital strategies, service delivery transformation, and citizen-centric design principles
- Understanding of public sector budget cycles, Treasury Board processes, government procurement frameworks, and contract vehicles
- Knowledge of relevant legislation and frameworks: Privacy Act, PIPEDA, PHIPA, Directive on Automated Decision-Making, Algorithmic Impact Assessments, accessibility requirements
- Experience with government cloud strategies and security frameworks: GC Cloud, PBMM, Protected environments, CCCS guidelines
- Proven ability to work with classified information and operate effectively in secure, compartmented environments
section_preferred:
- Bilingual (English/French) proficiency-a strong asset for working across the federal government
- 3+ years specifically managing GenAI, LLM, or conversational AI implementations
- Experience with specific Canadian public sector digital transformation initiatives: Canada.ca modernization, healthcare AI projects, Canadian Digital Service programs, or provincial digital government initiatives
- Direct experience working with Canadian defence, intelligence, public safety, or national security organizations
- Professional certifications: CSM, PMP, ITIL, or Canadian government-specific security training
- Experience with government collaboration platforms: GCdocs, GCworkspace, Protected collaboration tools
- Background in management consulting, systems integration, or digital transformation consulting for public sector clients
- Experience with any modern programming language (C++, C#, JavaScript, Python, etc.)

job_title: Member of Technical Staff, North Modelling (Evals)
salary_range: CA$250K – CA$535K • Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges
section_intro:
WHO ARE WE?
Join us!
Role overview:
North is Cohere's AI workspace platform for enterprises: a secure, customizable environment where companies can use AI across their real workflows while maintaining control over sensitive data.
North connects AI agents with workplace tools, applications, and business context, helping users delegate complex work, build automations, inspect outputs, and collaborate with AI in production environments.
As North becomes more capable, one of the most important questions is also one of the hardest: how do we know whether the model is actually getting better for the workflows customers care about?
This role is about being the voice of North inside modelling.
You will build the evaluation systems, feedback loops, and applied modelling workflows that make sure model progress translates into better product outcomes for North users.
You will work closely with North product teams, customer-facing teams, and modelling teams to define what "good" means across the product surface, turn real usage and product direction into high-quality evals, and use those evals to guide model selection, patches, and regular model updates.
This is neither a pure research role nor a conventional product engineering role.
It is a rigorous applied MLE role for someone who cares deeply about measurement, model behavior, and real-world product quality.
You should be excited by the craft of building careful evals: evals that capture messy agentic workflows, reflect actual customer needs, resist superficial benchmark hacking, and provide useful signal for where the product and models need to go next.
Please note: this team works closely across Europe and East Coast North America time zones.
We are open to candidates who can collaborate effectively within those hours.
section_responsibilities:
- Own the eval strategy for North: define what we need to measure across agent workflows, tool use, enterprise knowledge work such as deep research, document creation or editing, and other human-AI interactions.
- Build high-quality evals from the realities of the product: user feedback, production failures, privacy-preserving usage logs, internal dogfooding, customer needs, and forward-looking product goals.
- Create systems that continuously turn what North is learning from users, customers, and feature teams into evals, so measurement keeps pace with the product rather than becoming a static benchmark.
- Be the voice of North inside modelling: extract clear insight from eval results, customer-derived data and product context, then turn model failures, capability gaps, and North-specific needs into actionable recommendations for the central modelling teams.
section_requirements:
- You have improved LLM-powered, agent-powered, or AI-product systems through evals, feedback loops, data curation, prompting, model adaptation, or model selection.
- You care deeply about evaluation as a craft: representative tasks, precise rubrics, clean data, failure analysis, regression tracking, and knowing when a metric is giving false confidence.
- You have strong applied MLE judgment and can reason clearly about model behavior, eval validity, product outcomes, and production tradeoffs.
- You are comfortable working close to users and product teams, while translating messy qualitative signals into measurement that other modelling teams can act on.
- You are self-directed, practical, and motivated by open-ended problems where the right answer requires both technical depth and product understanding.
- You care about making AI systems genuinely useful in real enterprise settings, not just better on abstract benchmarks.
If some of the above does not line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

location: London; San Francisco; New York; Paris; Toronto; Montreal
salary_range: CA$250K – CA$535K • Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges
section_intro:
WHO ARE WE?
Join us!
Role Overview:
As a Member of Technical Staff in Data Analysis and Evaluation, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our large language models (LLMs).
Your primary focus will be on designing and conducting data collection tasks, assessing and evaluating dataset quality, and analysing the robustness and generalisability of our models.
You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including researchers, engineers, and data annotators, to conduct data-driven decision-making and improve the overall effectiveness of our AI systems.
This role combines expertise in statistics, experimental design incl. human annotators, and machine learning to ensure that our models are trained on high-quality data and perform reliably across diverse scenarios.
You will contribute to Cohere's mission of advancing AI by ensuring our systems are robust, scalable, and impactful.
Please Note: We have offices in London, Paris, Toronto, San Francisco, and New York, but we also embrace being remote-friendly!
There are no restrictions on where you can be located for this role.
section_responsibilities:
- Design and oversee data collection tasks, including supporting human annotators and ensuring data quality.
- Develop and apply statistical methods to evaluate the quality and reliability of datasets.
- Analyse and assess the generalisability and robustness of ML systems across diverse use cases.
- Collaborate with teams to improve dataset quality and model performance.
- Train and fine-tune large language models (LLMs) on distributed training infrastructures.
- Conduct experiments to evaluate model performance and identify areas for improvement.
section_requirements:
- Extremely strong software engineering skills.
- Strong expertise in designing and conducting data collection tasks, including working with human annotators.
- Strong statistical skills and experience evaluating scientific experiments related to data collection and model performance.
- Experience analysing datasets with respect to their quality, biases, and suitability for training ML models.
- Hands-on experience training large language models (LLMs) on distributed training infrastructures.
- Familiarity with evaluating and improving the generalisability and robustness of ML systems.
- Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX).
- Excellent communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and present findings.
- One or more papers at top-tier venues (such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AIStats, MLSys, JMLR, AAAI, Nature, COLING, ACL, EMNLP).
* This is neither an exhaustive nor necessary set of attributes.
Even if none of these apply to you, but you believe you will contribute to Cohere, please reach out.
We value diverse backgrounds and perspectives at Cohere.

section_about:
We are looking for a Senior Motion Designer to help shape how SpaceXSI moves and shows up in the world.
This role is built for someone who has built motion systems in fast-moving environments, cares deeply about craft, and brings an AI-first mindset to how creative work gets made.
You'll join the Brand Studio, the team behind the brand across the entire SpaceXSI ecosystem (from Grok and Grok Bot to X), and help define both the motion language of the brand and how it comes to life in our campaigns and products.
This is a hands-on role.
Much of the foundation is still being built, so you'll spend real time animating and making things yourself.
It also comes with significant ownership: you'll lead projects from first concept through final delivery, and your work will help set the bar for how the brand moves.
section_responsibilities:
- Motion system: Define and extend the brand's motion language (timing, easing, transitions, logo animation, typography in motion, and graphic behaviors) and document it so other teams can apply it correctly.
- Workflows & toolkits: Turn recurring motion work into repeatable, AI-assisted workflows: templates, tools, and generators that let marketing, product, and other teams produce on-brand motion without you in the room.
- Campaigns: Concept and produce motion end to end, from storyboards through final delivery, across launch films, product videos, social, paid, web, and out-of-home.
- Product motion: Partner with product designers and engineers to bring brand motion into product surfaces, from interactions and transitions to onboarding and launch moments.
- Creative direction: Direct agencies, animators, and freelancers with clear briefs and candid feedback so the output meets the bar you'd set yourself.
- Collaboration: Partner with marketing, product, engineering, and leadership; bring a motion point of view to new surfaces as they appear, and present your thinking clearly to senior stakeholders.
- Range at speed: Move between projects quickly while holding a consistently high bar, and keep improving the process, not just the output.
What you bring
- 6+ years of motion design experience, in-house or at an agency or studio.
- Fluency in After Effects, Cinema 4D or Blender, Figma, and Adobe Creative Cloud.
- Experience in AI coding tools, especially Cursor.
You can build your own tools, scripts, prototypes, and simple web pages instead of waiting on engineering.
- Hands-on experience with AI video and image generation tools as part of a real production workflow.
- A reel and portfolio that show both motion system work and shipped campaigns.
Bonus if they include tools or workflows you built.
- Sharp instincts for timing, rhythm, typography in motion, and storytelling.
- Experience in animation workflows from conceptualization, storyboard design, to execution
- A systems mindset: you naturally turn one-off tasks into reusable processes and think about how creative work scales.
- Conviction in your design decisions and the ability to explain why they matter, to designers, marketers, and leadership alike.
- Self-directed, fast, and energized by variety and ambiguity.
section_preferred:
- Experience building or relaunching a brand's motion identity at a fast-growing tech company.
- Experience with real-time or code-based motion, such as Rive, Lottie, or WebGL.
- 3D modeling, lighting, and rendering skills.
- Sound design sensibility, enough to work closely with audio partners.
- Experience leading agencies on large, multi-channel campaigns.

job_title: Senior Software Engineer - Distributed Data Systems
section_intro:
P-59
Modern data analysis employs sophisticated methods such as machine learning that go well beyond the roll-up and drill-down capabilities of traditional SQL query engines.
As a software engineer on the Runtime team at Databricks, you will be building the next generation distributed data storage and processing systems that can outperform specialized SQL query engines in relational query performance, yet provide the expressiveness and programming abstractions to support diverse workloads ranging from ETL to data science.
Below are some example projects:
Apache SparkTM: Develop the de facto open source standard framework for big data.
Data Plane Storage: Provide reliable and high performance services and client libraries for storing and accessing humongous amount of data on cloud storage backends, e.g., AWS S3, Azure Blob Store.
Delta Lake: A storage management system that combines the scale and cost-efficiency of data lakes, the performance and reliability of a data warehouse, and the low latency of streaming.
Its higher level abstractions and guarantees, including ACID transactions and time travel, drastically simplify the complexity of real-world data engineering architecture.
Delta Pipelines: It's difficult to manage even a single data engineering pipeline.
The goal of the Delta Pipelines project is to make it simple and possible to orchestrate and operate tens of thousands of data pipelines.
It provides a higher level abstraction for expressing data pipelines and enables customers to deploy, test & upgrade pipelines and eliminate operational burdens for managing and building high quality data pipelines.
Performance Engineering: Build the next generation query optimizer and execution engine that's fast, tuning free, scalable, and robust.
What we look for:
BS (or higher) in Computer Science, related technical field or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of production level experience in either Java, Scala or C++.
Strong foundation in algorithms and data structures and their real-world use cases.
Experience with distributed systems, databases, and big data systems (Apache SparkTM, Hadoop).

Local Pay Range

section_intro:
P-186
We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform, so our customers can focus on the high value challenges that are central to their own missions.
Founded in 2013 by the original creators of Apache SparkTM, Databricks has grown from a tiny corner office in Berkeley, California to a global organization with over 1000 employees.
Thousands of organizations, from small to Fortune 100, trust Databricks with their mission-critical workloads, making us one of the fastest growing SaaS companies in the world.
We constantly push the boundaries of data and AI technology, while simultaneously operating with the resilience, security and scale that is critical to making customers successful on our platform.
We develop and operate one of the largest scale software platforms.
The fleet consists of millions of virtual machines, generating terabytes of logs and processing exabytes of data per day.
At our scale, we regularly observe cloud hardware, network, and operating system faults, and our software must gracefully shield our customers from any of the above.
Modern data analysis employs sophisticated methods such as machine learning that go well beyond the roll-up and drill-down capabilities of traditional SQL query engines.
As a software engineer on the Runtime team at Databricks, you will be building the next generation distributed data storage and processing systems that can outperform specialized SQL query engines in relational query performance, yet provide the expressiveness and programming abstractions to support diverse workloads ranging from ETL to data science.
Below are some example projects:
Apache SparkTM: Develop the de facto open source standard framework for big data.
Data Plane Storage: Deliver reliable and high performance services and client libraries for storing and accessing humongous amount of data on cloud storage backends, e.g., AWS S3, Azure Blob Store.
Delta Lake: A storage management system that combines the scale and cost-efficiency of data lakes, the performance and reliability of a data warehouse, and the low latency of streaming.
Its higher level abstractions and guarantees, including ACID transactions and time travel, drastically simplify the complexity of real-world data engineering architecture.
Delta Pipelines: It's difficult to manage even a single data engineering pipeline.
The goal of the Delta Pipelines project is to make it simple and possible to orchestrate and operate tens of thousands of data pipelines.
It provides a higher level abstraction for expressing data pipelines and enables customers to deploy, test & upgrade pipelines and eliminate operational burdens for managing and building high quality data pipelines.
Performance Engineering: Build the next generation query optimizer and execution engine that's fast, tuning free, scalable, and robust.
What we look for:
BS in Computer Science, related technical field or equivalent practical experience.
Optional: MS or PhD in databases, distributed systems.
Driven by delivering customer value and impact.
8+ years of production level experience in either Java, Scala or C++.
Strong foundation in algorithms and data structures and their real-world use cases.
Experience with distributed systems, databases, and big data systems (Apache SparkTM, Hadoop).

P-188
Our mission at Databricks is to radically simplify the whole data lifecycle from ingestion to ETL, BI, and all the way up to ML/AI with a unified platform.
To achieve this goal, we believe the data warehouse architecture as we know it today will be replaced by a new architectural pattern, Lakehouse (CIDR 2021 paper), open platforms that unify data warehousing and advanced analytics.
The new architecture will help address several major challenges, including data staleness, reliability, total cost of ownership, data lock-in, and limited use-case support.
A critical part of realizing this vision is the next generation (decoupled) query engine and structured storage system that can outperform specialized data warehouses in relational query performance, yet retain the expressiveness and of general purpose systems such as Apache SparkTM to support diverse workloads ranging from ETL to data science.
As part of this team, you will be working in one or more of the following areas to design and implement these next gen systems that leapfrog state-of-the-art:
Query compilation and optimization
Distributed query execution and scheduling
Vectorized execution engine
Data security
Resource management
Transaction coordination
Efficient storage structures (encodings, indexes)
Automatic physical data optimization
What we look for:
A passion for database systems, storage systems, distributed systems, language design, or performance optimization
Experience working towards a multi-year vision with incremental deliverables
8+ years of experience working in a related system (preferred)
Optional: PhD in databases or distributed systems

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Infrastructure teams, you will build scalable systems to power the Databricks platform, making it the de-facto platform for running Big Data and AI workloads.
You will build and extend the Databricks infrastructure platform, which includes multi-cloud systems and services for managing thousands of Kubernetes clusters at scale, storing petabytes of data, highly scalable and distributed API gateways, rate limiting framework, network security and encryption, developer tools and infrastructure (we use Bazel), testing frameworks, and scalable CI/CD framework among many others.

Build and extend components of the core Databricks infrastructure
Architect multi-cloud systems and abstractions to allow the Databricks product to run on top of existing Cloud providers
Improve software development workflows for engineering and operational efficiency.
Use our own data and AI platform (yes!) to analyze build and test logs and metrics to identify areas for improvement.
Develop automated build, test, and release infrastructures.
Set and uphold the standard for engineering processes to support high-quality engineering, including style and code checking, test harnesses, and release packaging.
What we look for:
5+ years of experience writing production code in one of: Java, Scala, Go, C++ or Python
Passion for building highly scalable and reliable infrastructure
Experience architecting, developing and deploying large-scale distributed systems at scale
Experience with cloud APIs (e.g., a public cloud such as AWS, Azure, GCP or an advanced private cloud such as Google, Facebook)
Experience with cloud technologies, e.g.
AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, or Terraform.

job_title: Senior Software Engineer - Distributed Data Systems
section_intro:
P-59
Modern data analysis employs sophisticated methods such as machine learning that go well beyond the roll-up and drill-down capabilities of traditional SQL query engines.
As a software engineer on the Runtime team at Databricks, you will be building the next generation distributed data storage and processing systems that can outperform specialized SQL query engines in relational query performance, yet provide the expressiveness and programming abstractions to support diverse workloads ranging from ETL to data science.
Below are some example projects:
Apache SparkTM: Develop the de facto open source standard framework for big data.
Data Plane Storage: Provide reliable and high performance services and client libraries for storing and accessing humongous amount of data on cloud storage backends, e.g., AWS S3, Azure Blob Store.
Delta Lake: A storage management system that combines the scale and cost-efficiency of data lakes, the performance and reliability of a data warehouse, and the low latency of streaming.
Its higher level abstractions and guarantees, including ACID transactions and time travel, drastically simplify the complexity of real-world data engineering architecture.
Delta Pipelines: It's difficult to manage even a single data engineering pipeline.
The goal of the Delta Pipelines project is to make it simple and possible to orchestrate and operate tens of thousands of data pipelines.
It provides a higher level abstraction for expressing data pipelines and enables customers to deploy, test & upgrade pipelines and eliminate operational burdens for managing and building high quality data pipelines.
Performance Engineering: Build the next generation query optimizer and execution engine that's fast, tuning free, scalable, and robust.
What we look for:
BS (or higher) in Computer Science, related technical field or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of production level experience in either Java, Scala or C++.
Strong foundation in algorithms and data structures and their real-world use cases.
Experience with distributed systems, databases, and big data systems (Apache Spark, Hadoop).

section_intro:
Our mission at Databricks is to radically simplify the whole data lifecycle from ingestion to ETL, BI, and all the way up to ML/AI with a unified platform.
To achieve this goal, we believe the data warehouse architecture as we know it today will be replaced by a new architectural pattern, Lakehouse (CIDR 2021 paper), open platforms that unify data warehousing and advanced analytics.
The new architecture will help address several major challenges, including data staleness, reliability, total cost of ownership, data lock-in, and limited use-case support.
A critical part of realizing this vision is the next generation (decoupled) query engine and structured storage system that can outperform specialized data warehouses in relational query performance, yet retain the expressiveness and of general purpose systems such as Apache SparkTM to support diverse workloads ranging from ETL to data science.
As part of this team, you will be working in one or more of the following areas to design and implement these next gen systems that leapfrog state-of-the-art:
Query compilation and optimization
Distributed query execution and scheduling
Vectorized execution engine
Data security
Resource management
Transaction coordination
Efficient storage structures (encodings, indexes)
Automatic physical data optimization
What we look for:
A passion for database systems, storage systems, distributed systems, language design, or performance optimization
Experience working towards a multi-year vision with incremental deliverables
5+ years of experience working in a related system (preferred)
Optional: PhD in databases or distributed systems

section_intro:

We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform, so our customers can focus on the high value challenges that are central to their own missions.
Our mission at Databricks is to radically simplify the whole data lifecycle from ingestion to ETL, BI, and all the way up to ML/AI with a unified platform.
To achieve this goal, we believe the data warehouse architecture as we know it today will be replaced by a new architectural pattern, Lakehouse (CIDR 2021 paper), open platforms that unify data warehousing and advanced analytics.

Resource management
Transaction coordination

job_title: Senior Software Engineer - Distributed Data Systems
section_intro:
P-987
Modern data analysis employs sophisticated methods such as machine learning that go well beyond the roll-up and drill-down capabilities of traditional SQL query engines.
As a software engineer on the Runtime team at Databricks, you will be building the next generation distributed data storage and processing systems that can outperform specialized SQL query engines in relational query performance, yet provide the expressiveness and programming abstractions to support diverse workloads ranging from ETL to data science.
Below are some example projects:
Apache SparkTM: Develop the de facto open source standard framework for big data.
Data Plane Storage: Provide reliable and high performance services and client libraries for storing and accessing humongous amount of data on cloud storage backends, e.g., AWS S3, Azure Blob Store.
Delta Lake: A storage management system that combines the scale and cost-efficiency of data lakes, the performance and reliability of a data warehouse, and the low latency of streaming.
Its higher level abstractions and guarantees, including ACID transactions and time travel, drastically simplify the complexity of real-world data engineering architecture.
Delta Pipelines: It's difficult to manage even a single data engineering pipeline.
The goal of the Delta Pipelines project is to make it simple and possible to orchestrate and operate tens of thousands of data pipelines.
It provides a higher level abstraction for expressing data pipelines and enables customers to deploy, test & upgrade pipelines and eliminate operational burdens for managing and building high quality data pipelines.
Performance Engineering: Build the next generation query optimizer and execution engine that's fast, tuning free, scalable, and robust.
What we look for:
BS (or higher) in Computer Science, related technical field or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of production level experience in either Java, Scala or C++.
Strong foundation in algorithms and data structures and their real-world use cases.
Experience with distributed systems, databases, and big data systems (Apache Spark, Hadoop).
Pay Range Transparency
Local Pay Range

P-57
At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems.
We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform, so our customers can focus on the high value challenges that are central to their own missions.
Founded in 2013 by the original creators of Apache Spark, Databricks has grown from a tiny corner office in Berkeley, California to a global organization with over 1000 employees.
Thousands of organizations, from small to Fortune 100, trust Databricks with their mission-critical workloads, making us one of the fastest growing SaaS companies in the world.
We constantly push the boundaries of data and AI technology, while simultaneously operating with the resilience, security and scale that is critical to making customers successful on our platform.
We develop and operate one of the largest scale software platforms.
The fleet consists of millions of virtual machines, generating terabytes of logs and processing exabytes of data per day.
At our scale, we regularly observe cloud hardware, network, and operating system faults, and our software must gracefully shield our customers from any of the above.
As a Data Scientist on the Data Team, you will help build a data-driven culture within Databricks by helping work on top priorities for the company.
The Data team also functions as an in-house, production "customer" that dog foods Databricks and drives the future direction of the products.
The impact you will have:
"Analysis at the speed of thought": Inform decision making by building robust data science tooling for business leaders, analysts, and other data scientists.
"Extend capabilities of Databricks": Work closely with Data Platform and Product Engineering teams to integrate data science tooling with existing Data team offerings and the core product
"Strategic business insights": Lead insight generation for top company priorities, and key Engineering initiatives (reliability, and efficiency).
Gather changing requirements, define project OKRs and milestones, and communicate progress and results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Mentor and guide junior data scientists on the team by helping with project planning, technical decisions, and code and document review.
Represent the data science discipline throughout the organization, having a powerful voice to make us more data-driven.
Represent Databricks at academic and industrial conferences & events.
What we look for:

section_intro: About Decagon
section_about:
The Accounting team owns the numbers at a rapidly scaling startup.
We ensure accurate, timely financial reporting in accordance with U.S.
GAAP while designing scalable processes and strong controls that support expansion across teams and geographies.
Partnering closely with Sales, People, Legal, and Operations, we drive thoughtful spend management, contract oversight, and operational excellence, balancing precision with agility in a fast-moving environment where our work directly enables the company's next stage of growth.
We're looking for a technically strong Technical Accounting & Financial Reporting Manager to own complex, non-routine accounting matters as Decagon scales.
This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who thrives on solving thorny GAAP questions, revenue recognition, business combinations, and stock-based compensation among them, and can turn them into clear, well-documented conclusions the business can act on.
You'll partner closely with Legal, Sales, Founders Office, Revenue Operations, and Finance to help dictate and guide deal structure and pricing strategy before new products and deals go to market while helping build the technical accounting infrastructure, policies, memos, and controls that a fast-growing, pre-IPO company needs.
section_responsibilities:
- Own technical accounting positions under U.S.
GAAP for complex transactions, including revenue recognition (ASC 606), business combinations (ASC 805), and stock-based compensation (ASC 718), with audit-ready memos behind every conclusion
- Review non-standard customer contracts with Legal, Sales, Founders Office, Revenue Operations, and Finance, and get the revenue treatment right on new products and pricing before they are rolled out
- Own equity and stock-based compensation accounting, including 409A and award valuations with external specialists, plus M&A and financing activity as it comes up
- Build Decagon's technical accounting policies from the ground up that hold up as we scale
- Drive conclusions with external auditors and technical consultants, and raise the rigor of external reporting as we approach IPO readiness
- Track new accounting standards and tell leadership what they mean for us, in plain terms
- Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA or equivalent designation preferred
- 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including a combination of Big 4/public accounting and industry experience at a high-growth technology or SaaS company
- Deep, hands-on technical accounting expertise in ASC 606, 805 and 718, with demonstrated experience drafting memos on complex, non-routine transactions
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical accounting conclusions for non-finance stakeholders
- A self-starter who's comfortable owning ambiguous, high-stakes problems independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Even better if you have
- Experience with lease accounting (ASC 842), capitalized software (ASC 350-40), or debt and equity instruments (ASC 480)
- Familiarity with ERP and financial reporting tools
- Experience using AI and automation tools to accelerate technical accounting research, memo drafting, or audit support

section_intro: About Decagon
section_about:
Truly successful AI Agents require guidance and input throughout the development lifecycle.
As part of the Agent Experience Design team, you'll help shape what great AI conversation experiences look and sound like - across channels and languages, for enterprise customers around the world.
You'll work directly with customers and internal teams to improve agent quality - especially in voice, one of our fastest growing channels - and build the systems and resources that allow us to scale your expertise.
This work spans research, design, enablement, and product strategy.
You might:
- Advise customers and internal teams on conversation design and voice selection
- Evaluate and iterate on voice quality across providers, languages, and use cases
- Build playbooks, rubrics, and evaluation frameworks that scale best practices across the team
- Partner with Engineering and Product to translate field insights into platform improvements
Your insights will shape how Decagon deploys AI in mission-critical contexts and how we build toward the next generation of intelligent systems.
section_responsibilities:
- Design and optimize enterprise-grade AI conversation experiences across chat, voice, SMS, and email channels
- Serve as a trusted advisor to customers and internal stakeholders on conversation design best practices
- Evaluate voice quality and interaction patterns to maintain a high bar for naturalness and appropriateness
- Build repeatable frameworks for assessing conversation and voice performance
- Enable our Customer team to apply strong design judgment independently
- Partner crossfunctionally with Engineering and Product to investigate quality gaps and drive improvements through clear recommendations
- Share learnings and create documentation on best practices to improve consistency and raise the quality bar across deployments
- 3-5+ years of relevant experience (e.g., voice experience design, conversation designer, product manager, applied linguistics, etc.)
- Experience building evaluation frameworks, rubrics, or QA processes
- Strong communicator across technical and business contexts
- Comfortable working close to the product in a fast-moving environment
Even better if you have
- Native or professional fluency in Spanish and/or familiarity with other languages
- Experience with TTS providers or speech synthesis tools
- Hands-on experience with frontier AI tools and deployment in enterprise or high-impact settings

section_intro: About Decagon

You'll help shape our healthcare strategy, build trusted relationships with senior industry leaders, and translate those relationships into strategic partnerships and commercial growth.
Working closely with Decagon's founders, executive team, and healthcare go-to-market leaders, you'll identify where AI agents can deliver the greatest value across healthcare.
You'll bring a strong understanding of healthcare economics, organizational structures, and operational challenges, from claims and contact centers to patient access, pharmacy, and care management.
This role combines industry strategy, executive relationship development, and commercial execution, requiring the judgment and credibility to navigate complex healthcare organizations and position AI solutions in a highly regulated environment.

Identify priority segments, accounts, use cases, and partnerships to accelerate Decagon's expansion across the U.S. healthcare market.
- Build executive relationships.
Develop trusted relationships with C-suite executives, senior decision-makers, and industry leaders across Payer, Provider, Life Sciences, and Health Tech.
- Advance strategic opportunities.
Partner with Decagon's founders and healthcare go-to-market teams to originate and accelerate enterprise opportunities, navigate complex buying processes, and build alignment across business, clinical, technology, and compliance stakeholders.
- Connect technology to business outcomes.
Identify high-value applications for AI agents across healthcare operations, balancing business impact with clinical safety, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
- Develop strategic partnerships.
Build relationships with consulting firms, systems integrators, EHR and health-tech platforms, contact center and BPO partners, and industry associations to expand Decagon's reach.
- Activate our investor and advisor networks.

- Represent Decagon in the market.
Engage healthcare leaders through executive briefings, industry conferences, private events, and partner meetings.
- Bring market insight into Decagon.
Translate customer and partner feedback into recommendations for positioning, product priorities, and healthcare-specific trust and compliance requirements.

- An entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to set priorities, operate independently, and execute in a fast-moving environment.
- Willingness to travel for executive meetings, industry events, and strategic opportunities.

section_intro: About Decagon
section_about:
Decagon builds mission-critical AI products that impact millions of users and directly drive our customers' success.
Our New York engineering teams build products and foundational systems across customer support, growth and new verticals.
We're hiring Engineering Managers to lead these teams, shape their technical direction and grow products with meaningful business impact.
As an Engineering Manager, Agent Product, you'll lead a team of generalist product engineers owning one or more product areas end to end - from identifying opportunities and shaping the roadmap to building, shipping and continuously improving the product.
Your team's primary responsibility is to build reusable products and systems.
You'll stay close to users and customers to inform product decisions, while partnering with product and design to deliver solutions that scale.
Managers here are expected to operate with high ownership and technical depth while helping their teams move quickly and maintain a high quality bar.
This role is for someone who enjoys mentoring engineers, exercising product judgment and diving deep into complex technical challenges.
Teams we're hiring for in New York
- Growth: Build internal products that power our sales team - identifying ideal customers, helping reps decide how to engage and directly driving revenue growth.
- Enterprise Data Lifecycle: Build the critical systems behind our enterprise data privacy and retention commitments.
This team tackles distributed systems challenges with a high bar for scale and correctness, builds capabilities used by our largest enterprise customers, and runs and evaluates its own models.
- Collections: Build our product for the debt collection vertical, partnering with external design partners to discover user needs, iterate on the product and prove its value in a new market.
- Proactive Agents: Build our outbound, proactive agent product.
Learn more about Proactive Agents
section_responsibilities:
- Lead and grow a team of generalist product engineers owning a product area and its underlying systems
- Partner with product and design to identify high-impact opportunities, define the roadmap and translate user needs into scalable products
- Drive execution across the full product development lifecycle, from discovery and technical design through launch, iteration and optimization
- Help define technical strategy, making thoughtful tradeoffs across user experience, reliability, performance and speed of delivery
- Build reusable capabilities that serve users across customers, rather than one-off customer implementations
- Stay close to users and customers, using feedback and product outcomes to guide priorities
- Support and mentor engineers through technical guidance, feedback and career development
- Maintain a high engineering bar while fostering a culture of ownership, velocity and customer obsession
- Have 1+ years of engineering management experience
- Have 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering
- Experience leading teams building customer-facing products or complex distributed systems, with ownership from technical design through launch and iteration
- Strong product judgment and experience partnering closely with product and design
- Proficiency with Python, Typescript and asynchronous programming
- A high degree of comfort digging into system failures within deep technology stacks using any tool necessary
- Strong communication skills and the ability to connect technical decisions to user needs and business outcomes
Even better
- Experience leading teams working on AI systems, LLM applications or agentic workflows
- Prior experience working with multi-modal models
- Experience building products in new markets or scaling enterprise systems with demanding reliability and correctness requirements
